srs.discovery_gate_note: NO EXPLICIT GATE-APPROVAL STAMP EXISTS ON ANY INPUT ARTEFACT, AND THIS IS RECORDED RATHER THAN GLOSSED. The skill directs that generation STOP if any discovery artefact lacks a gate-approved stamp. No input artefact carries such a stamp, a readiness-check record, or any approval field: searching the whole staged input set for gate, readiness or approval language returns only an accessibility gate decision of FAIL, the quality-risk escalation triggers, and the open stakeholder escalation ESC-1. The date above is therefore the assessment and extraction date common to every input artefact (business-logic extraction_date 2026-10-02T18:05:00Z; quality-risk, ux-accessibility, compliance-citations and capability-catalog assessed_date 2026-10-02), NOT the date a readiness check passed. This SRS was generated because the inputs are complete, internally cross-validated and individually schema-conformant, and because every finding it rests on is cited to a file and line a reviewer can check. The absence of a formal gate record is carried as an open question for the engagement owner, together with the two gate-relevant facts that ARE recorded: the accessibility gate verdict is FAIL, and escalation ESC-1 is open with status open and no owner assigned.
